verdict.rationale: Relay documents automatic syncing of detailed transaction data, receipts, and categorized expenses directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero, which reduces manual journal entries. However, the evidence only describes a one-way push into small-business accounting software, not a real-time, bidirectional ERP sync. Missing for 10: evidence of bidirectional sync (changes flowing from the accounting system back to Relay), confirmed real-time sync latency, support for true ERP systems beyond QBO/Xero, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
